base_prompt: Create a NEW full-body 2D anime pixel-art character, about 20 years old. Use the reference only for its visual style, proportions, pixel density and framing, never its identity. Follow the requested skin tone, eye color, hair color, hairstyle and tattoos exactly; make them visibly distinct. Medieval or pre-industrial fantasy only. Use a subtle non-flat pixel texture behind the character, built from 2-4 lineage palette colors and its cultural motif; no detailed scene.
negative_prompt: No copied face, default repeated hairstyle, wrong skin or eye color, old or child face, white/checkerboard/flat background, modern or futuristic gear, guns, sci-fi armor, cyberpunk, realism, painting, blur, cropped body, 3D, text, UI, logo or watermark.

ardhen_male.prompt: Ardhen man: tan skin; dark-hazel eyes; short chestnut hair with rough side part. Basalt tunic, slate vest, copper buckles, belt, wraps, boots, masonry hammer. Angular stone-line tattoos on forearms. Sturdy and dependable. Background texture: stone grain, supports and copper seams. Palette: basalt, slate, copper, ochre, quarry beige.

ardhen_female.prompt: Ardhen woman: bronze skin; warm-brown eyes; long dark-umber hair in a low braided ponytail with loose side locks. Slate jerkin, beige sleeves, copper details, work belt, rope or brace tool, boots. Geometric quarry tattoos on shoulder and forearm. Resilient. Background texture: stone grain and copper seams. Palette: slate, charcoal, copper, amber, quarry beige.
